description: This file defines the class Popup_Picker, which appears to handle the popup interface for selecting email records within the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for generating search clauses, processing the popup page, and rendering HTML output including search forms and list views. The code interacts with global variables, templates, and list view components specific to SuiteCRM.

classes.name: Popup_Picker
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering and handling the email popup selection interface, including search functionality and list display within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the Popup_Picker class. Currently empty.

methods.name: _get_where_clause
methods.description: Generates a SQL WHERE clause based on search parameters received via $_REQUEST, handling 'name' and 'contact_name' filters.

methods.name: process_page
methods.description: Main method that processes the popup page request, constructs the HTML output, and sets up the list view of emails with search and control buttons.
